description: Awesome Electrical Grid Mapping (MapYourGrid list of grid maps, datasets and resources) is a curated catalogue listed in Awesome Electrical Grid Mapping, a curated list of electrical grid maps, datasets and resources, published or maintained by Open Energy Transition and the MapYourGrid initiative. It lists about 1,000 links to electricity transmission and distribution maps, open datasets, planning reports and hosting-capacity maps for almost every country, grouped by continent and country, plus sections on crowdsourced mapping in OpenStreetMap, remote-sensing and machine-learning methods for mapping grids, and a Global Transmission Length Index covering 131 countries. Coverage: worldwide, with entries for most countries and many states and provinces. The README carries a link-health badge and a contribution format of country, title, link, year, licence and tags (capacity data, dataset, map, report). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the README (see the repository licence file). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transmission and distribution network screening, grid model building and hosting-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-electrical-grid-mapping, data-open-infrastructure-map, data-mapyourgrid-osm-grid-mapping-initiative.
